[center][color=#b4a7d6][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/idaidaart][color=#9900ff]♡[/color][/url][color=#d9d2e9]

[/color]
